fields.summary_ko.0: Apple's Q4 revenue exceeded expectations but iPad sales weakness and lack of margin guidance caused 3.8% decline in pre-market trading, with rising memory costs pressuring profitability.
fields.summary_ko.1: Palantir achieved nearly 2x year-over-year revenue growth reaching $200 million in Q3 results, but U.S. commercial TCV bookings growth decelerated to 11%, causing 7.8% pre-market decline.
